title: AB 1175 (2025-2026 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): student identification acceptable for voting.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) s. 5.02 (6m) (f) as amended (student ID cards)
(quote) 5.02 (6m) (f) An unexpired identification card issued by a university or college in this state that is accredited, as defined in s. 39.30 (1) (d), or by a technical college in this state that is a member of and governed by the technical college system under ch. 38, that contains the date of issuance and signature of the individual to whom it is issued and that contains an expiration date indicating that the card expires no later than 6 years after the date of issuance if the individual establishes that he or she is enrolled as a student at the university or college on the date that the card is presented.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): This bill provides that the student identification card’s expiration date may be up to six years after the date of issuance, rather than two.

sponsors.name: Clancy
sponsors.version: As introduced 3/19/2026; referred to committee; died (Failed to pass pursuant to Senate Joint Resolution 1, 3/23/2026)
